article.headline: Charlotte earns 85-72 win over Northern Iowa
article.description: — Arden Conyers’ 24 points helped Charlotte defeat Northern Iowa 85-72 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Charlotte earns 85-72 win over Northern Iowa
article.story: CYPRESS LAKE, Fla. -- — Arden Conyers’ 24 points helped Charlotte defeat Northern Iowa 85-72 on Wednesday. Conyers had five rebounds for the 49ers (5-2). Keyshuan Tillery added 15 points while shooting 5 for 14, including 3 for 7 from beyond the arc while they also had five assists. Dylan Grant had 13 points and shot 3 of 6 from the field and 7 for 8 from the line. Carson Vis led the Panthers (3-5) in scoring, finishing with 19 points and three steals. Northern Iowa also got 18 points from Greyson Uelmen. Isaiah Johnson-Arigu also had 15 points and two steals. Charlotte took the lead for good with 17:24 left in the game. Conyers helped his team pull away for the victory with 14 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
